title: Lung cancer demo pool (8 trials)
description: A fixed set of non-small cell lung cancer trials from ClinicalTrials.gov, chosen by hand for demonstrations: first-line EGFR-mutant trials alongside trials for other mutations or for patients already treated, so a ranking has something to separate. Not a complete or current list of open trials.
